protocol.name: frozen-feature-v3
protocol.split_method: StratifiedKFold on sorted unique source groups, expanded to image rows; every source group has one class
protocol.tie_break: within absolute tolerance of best score: candidate declaration order, then ascending C
protocol.sample_weight: none; unweighted per-image fit with fixed class_weight=balanced
protocol.convergence_policy: fail run on ConvergenceWarning; no automatic solver or protocol change
protocol.split_failure_policy: fail before scored fits if class support or group isolation is invalid; no adaptive fallback
protocol.precision: float32; no autocast; patch std correction=0; TF32 disabled
protocol.preprocess: PIL RGB; EXIF transpose; resize shorter edge floor(size/crop_pct) with PIL bicubic; longer edge floor; rounded center crop; float32 /255; model mean/std
protocol.foreground_crop: not included; model-specific deterministic center preprocessing only

interpretation.primary: Nested selection-procedure OOF research estimate on all historical development data, including the old test split.
interpretation.candidate_oof: Descriptive predeclared candidate ablations with C selected in each outer training partition.
interpretation.control_oof: Predeclared ConvNeXt control; C selected independently in each outer training partition.
interpretation.final: Selected by grouped inner CV on all development data, then fitted on all development data. Also export independently C-selected all-development ConvNeXt control. No new test is used.
interpretation.fresh_holdout: Apply final saved recipe, scaler and head without fitting; evaluate only after selection is frozen.
